title: Bakery and Promise
author: Jude Blackwood
blurb: Oscar Blackwood, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
